name: Import redirect JSON
description: Imports URL redirects from a JSON file into the Redirect module.
project_description:
This module allows you to import redirects from a JSON file uisng UI and allows you to map the key properties from a JSON object.

 Installations: 

As usaul, use composer to download composer require drupal/import_redirect_json .

 Dependencies: 

 
 Redirect 
 Database logging (in the core) 
 
 Configurations: 

Go to /admin/config/search/redirect/import-redirect-json/mapping path and map the fields.

 See in action: 

Go to /admin/config/search/redirect/import-redirect-json path and upload a JSON file with mapped pattern. You will see an example on the import form based on your mapping fields. (See below an example)

 [

 {

 "source_path": "/from-url",

 "destination": "internal:/node/{ID}",

 "status_code": "301",

 "language": "en"

 }

] 

 Looking forward to see new issues 😄

 Thanks,
